newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta firm launches investment fund.
newsitem.headline: Malta firm launches investment fund.

text.p: Malt's Tri-Med Fund Management Ltd on Wednesday announced it was to launch its first fund, the Tri-Med Malta Accumulator Fund SICAV.

It said the fund's objective is to achieve capital growth by investing in income-generated securities and other assets denominated in Maltese pounds. Income will be re-invested in securities and assets.
The fund will not distribute income, but investors will be able to sell any part or all of their holding at any time.
Tri-Med said the fund did not have any initial charge. Investors would be charged an exit fee of one percent of the net asset value of any sale or transfer of units.
Minimum investment has been set at 100,000 pounds, but this is expected to be reviewed and a lower limit set.
The fund will be listed on the Malta Stock Exchange.
Tri-Med was set up in October between Mid-Med Bank (49 percent) Deatsche Fonds Holding GmbH (41 percent) and APS Bank Ltd (10 percent).
